messages:
Diego M.: hi team! quick Q for my first week — where should i post: 1) a short intro + team shoutout, 2) desk/monitor preference, 3) an urgent pager question if i'm oncall? also which onboarding bots should i turn on? trying to keep notifications sane.

Alex (People Ops): welcome Diego! intro + shoutout -> this channel (#new-hires) is perfect for a one-paragraph intro. desk/monitor -> #people-ops with the hardware form link. urgent pager issues -> escalate to #eng-oncall (and @eng-oncall). Bot guidance: enable hr-notify, calendar-bot. Hold off on repo-notifs and ci-builds unless your manager asks.

Priya (Eng SRE): adding — if you get a pager, DM the oncall first and then post an incident summary in #incidents if it affects prod. For paging etiquette: include service name, brief symptom, and top 2 things you've tried. Examples are pinned in #eng-oncall.

Nora (DevEx): for bots: standup-bot is opt-in by team; calendar-bot is safe (reminders). If you enable build-notifs, route them to a team channel. To see current bot subscriptions use /bot subscriptions or check pinned bots in this channel.

IT-Bot: Hardware request: https://internal/forms/hardware. Badge & desk assign: submit form and cc people-ops. Access request for service accounts: /it new-access.

Diego M.: good call on routing builds. one follow-up: are casual posts like lunch or hobby groups okay in #random or should i use department channels?

Alex (People Ops): #random is fine for non-work social stuff — just keep it light. For interest groups (gaming, running), there's a #groups directory with dedicated channels so it scales better.

Priya (Eng SRE): small tip: avoid turning on noisy bots in shared channels where multiple teams converge (e.g., #eng). If you're unsure, test notifications in a personal channel first.

Calendar-Bot: Reminder set: Diego M. intro call with mentor at 3:00pm today. RSVP: yes / no / maybe.

Diego M.: thanks everyone — i'll post intro here shortly and file the hardware form. appreciate the signal on bot hygiene :thumbsup:
